content: मज्जनम् [मस्ज्-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Sinking, plunging, sinking under water, immersion. .²2 Inundating, deluging. .²3 Bathing, ablution; प्रत्यग्रमज्जनविशेषविविक्तकान्तिः <ls>Ratn. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 57</ls>. .²4 Drowning. .²5 The marrow of the bones and flesh (= मज्जन्).
मज्जनः An elephant in the eighth year; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 9</ls>.
